note: Common: 交稅 pay tax; 加稅 raise taxes.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 go3 jyut6 jiu3 gaau1 seoi3
ex.en: I have to pay my taxes this month.

ex.r: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin4 baau1 m4 baau1 seoi3 gaa3
ex.en: Does this price include tax?

ex.s: 喺香港買嘢唔使俾銷售稅。
ex.r: hai2 hoeng1 gong2 maai5 je5 m4 sai2 bei2 siu1 sau6 seoi3
ex.en: In Hong Kong you don't pay sales tax when shopping.

ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 daa2 gwok3 zai3 coeng4 tou4 din6 waa2
ex.en: I need to make an international call.

ex.s: 佢喺一間國際學校教書。
ex.r: keoi5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 gwok3 zai3 hok6 haau6 gaau3 syu1
ex.en: She teaches at an international school.

ex.s: 我哋坐國際航班，要早啲到機場。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 co5 gwok3 zai3 hong4 baan1 jiu3 zou2 di1 dou3 gei1 coeng4
ex.en: We're on an international flight, so we need to get to the airport early.

ex.r: coeng4 cing4 ngo5 ci4 di1 nei5
ex.en: I'll WhatsApp you the details later.

ex.s: 想知詳情可以打呢個電話。
ex.r: soeng2 zi1 coeng4 cing4 ho2 ji5 daa2 ni1 go3 din6 waa2
ex.en: For details, you can call this number.

ex.r: go3 ji1 sang1 zung6 mei6 gong2 coeng4 cing4
ex.en: The doctor hasn't given the details yet.

note: HK's school-leaving exam is 文憑試 (the DSE).

ex.s: 我讀完呢個課程就有張文憑。
ex.r: ngo5 duk6 jyun4 ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 zau6 jau5 zoeng1 man4 pang4
ex.en: When I finish this course, I'll get a diploma.

ex.r: keoi5 sai3 lou2 gam1 nin4 haau2 man4 pang4 si3
ex.en: Her younger brother takes the DSE this year.

ex.s: 份工要求有文憑或以上。
ex.r: fan6 gung1 jiu1 kau4 jau5 man4 pang4 waak6 ji5 soeng6
ex.en: The job requires a diploma or higher.

note: From English 'number'; colloquial for 號碼 hou6 maa5.

ex.r: nei5 bei2 go3 din6 waa2 lam1 baa2 ngo5 aa1
ex.en: Give me your phone number.

ex.r: nei5 gaan1 fong2 me1 lam1 baa2 aa3
ex.en: What's your room number?

ex.r: dang2 ngo5 wan2 haa5 keoi5 go3 lam1 baa2 sin1
ex.en: Let me look up her number first.

note: Also a place at a school: 搵學位 = look for a school place.

ex.r: keoi5 jau5 sek6 si6 hok6 wai2
ex.en: She has a master's degree.

ex.s: 我日頭返工，夜晚讀學位。
ex.r: ngo5 jat6 tau2 faan1 gung1 je6 maan5 duk6 hok6 wai2
ex.en: I work during the day and study for a degree at night.

ex.s: 我哋仲幫個仔搵緊小學學位。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 zung6 bong1 go3 zai2 wan2 gan2 siu2 hok6 hok6 wai2
ex.en: We're still looking for a primary school place for our son.

note: Mandarin 土豆 / 馬鈴薯 aren't used in speech.

ex.s: 今晚煮薯仔炆牛肉好唔好？
ex.r: gam1 maan5 zyu2 syu4 zai2 man1 ngau4 juk6 hou2 m4 hou2
ex.en: How about beef braised with potatoes tonight?

ex.r: gaai1 si5 di1 syu4 zai2 gam1 jat6 hou2 peng4
ex.en: Potatoes at the market are cheap today.

ex.s: 我唔食薯仔，唔該走咗佢。
ex.r: ngo5 m4 sik6 syu4 zai2 m4 goi1 zau2 zo2 keoi5
ex.en: I don't eat potatoes; please leave them out.

note: Children call any grown man 叔叔.

ex.r: faai3 di1 tung4 suk1 suk1 gong2 do1 ze6
ex.en: Quick, say thank you to the nice man.

ex.r: ngo5 suk1 suk1 zyu6 hai2 gaa1 naa4 daai6
ex.en: My uncle lives in Canada.

ex.r: go3 bou2 on1 suk1 suk1 hou2 hou2 jan4
ex.en: The security guard is really nice.

note: Often with 嚟 / 去 / 地: 跌落嚟, 跌落地.

ex.r: siu2 sam1 di1 m4 hou2 dit3 lok6 lai4
ex.en: Careful, don't fall off.

ex.r: ngo5 bou6 sau2 gei1 dit3 lok6 dei6 laan6 zo2
ex.en: My phone fell on the floor and broke.

ex.s: 佢喺樓梯跌落去，扭親腳。
ex.r: keoi5 hai2 lau4 tai1 dit3 lok6 heoi3 nau2 can1 goek3
ex.en: He fell down the stairs and twisted his ankle.

ex.r: keoi5 keoi5 zyut6 zo2 ngo5 ge3 jiu1 cing2
ex.en: She turned down my invitation.

ex.s: 銀行拒絕咗我張信用卡申請。
ex.r: ngan4 hong4 keoi5 zyut6 zo2 ngo5 zoeng1 seon3 jung6 kaat1 san1 cing2
ex.en: The bank rejected my credit card application.

ex.r: nei5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 ho2 ji5 keoi5 zyut6 gaa3
ex.en: If you don't want to go, you can say no.

ex.r: ngo5 cung1 loeng4 seon6 bin2 sai2 tau4
ex.en: I'll wash my hair while I shower.

ex.s: 喺髮型屋洗頭幾多錢呀？
ex.r: hai2 faat3 jing4 uk1 sai2 tau4 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3
ex.en: How much is a hair wash at the salon?

ex.r: ngo5 zaap6 gwaan3 je6 maan5 sai2 tau4
ex.en: I usually wash my hair at night.

ex.r: ni1 paai2 keoi5 dei6 gin3 min6 hou2 pan4 mat6
ex.en: They've been seeing each other a lot lately.

ex.s: 地鐵班次好頻密，唔使等好耐。
ex.r: dei6 tit3 baan1 ci3 hou2 pan4 mat6 m4 sai2 dang2 hou2 noi6
ex.en: MTR trains come often, so you don't wait long.

ex.s: 你咳得咁頻密，去睇醫生啦。
ex.r: nei5 kat1 dak1 gam3 pan4 mat6 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1 laa1
ex.en: You're coughing so often; go see a doctor.

note: Colloquial 好精 = savvy; can hint at being calculating.

ex.s: 佢買嘢好精，識得搵平貨。
ex.r: keoi5 maai5 je5 hou2 zing1 sik1 dak1 wan2 peng4 fo3
ex.en: She shops smart and knows how to find bargains.

ex.r: nei5 go3 zai2 hou2 zing1 aa3 mat1 dou1 sik1
ex.en: Your son is so clever, he knows everything.

ex.s: 佢做生意好精，唔會蝕底。
ex.r: keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 hou2 zing1 m4 wui5 sit6 dai2
ex.en: He's shrewd in business and never loses out.

en: to endure; hold back; put up with
note: 忍唔住 = can't help (doing).

ex.r: ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 zo2 ceot1 lai4
ex.en: I couldn't help laughing.

ex.r: zau6 faai3 dou3 laa3 nei5 jan2 do1 zan6 laa1
ex.en: We're almost there; hold on a bit longer.

ex.s: 我個老闆好難頂，我忍咗佢好耐。
ex.r: ngo5 go3 lou5 baan2 hou2 naan4 ding2 ngo5 jan2 zo2 keoi5 hou2 noi6
ex.en: My boss is unbearable; I've put up with him for ages.

note: Usually a public housing estate; measure word 個.

ex.r: ngo5 sai3 go3 hai2 uk1 cyun1 daai6
ex.en: I grew up in a housing estate.

ex.s: 屋村樓下有間茶餐廳好好食。
ex.r: uk1 cyun1 lau4 haa6 jau5 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 hou2 hou2 sik6
ex.en: There's a great diner downstairs in the estate.

ex.r: ni1 go3 uk1 cyun1 jau5 gei2 do1 zo6 aa3
ex.en: How many blocks does this estate have?

ex.r: keoi5 dei6 syun1 bou3 zo2 haa6 nin2 git3 fan1
ex.en: They announced they're getting married next year.

ex.r: gung1 si1 syun1 bou3 ting1 jat6 fong3 gaa3
ex.en: The company announced a day off tomorrow.

ex.s: 天文台宣佈掛八號風球。
ex.r: tin1 man4 toi4 syun1 bou3 gwaa3 baat3 hou6 fung1 kau4
ex.en: The Observatory announced Typhoon Signal No. 8.

note: Mandarin 脖子 isn't used; 頸巾 = scarf.

ex.r: ngo5 fan3 m4 hou2 geng2 hou2 tung3
ex.en: I slept badly and my neck hurts.

ex.r: ceot1 min6 hou2 dung3 daai3 maai4 geng2 gan1 laa1
ex.en: It's cold out; wear a scarf too.

ex.s: 成日望住手機，頸都硬晒。
ex.r: seng4 jat6 mong6 zyu6 sau2 gei1 geng2 dou1 ngaang6 saai3
ex.en: Staring at my phone all day, my neck is stiff.

note: Measure word 篇.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 gon2 leon6 man2
ex.en: I have to rush my thesis tonight.

ex.r: nei5 pin1 leon6 man2 se2 sing4 dim2 aa3
ex.en: How's your paper coming along?

ex.s: 教授話我篇論文寫得幾好。
ex.r: gaau3 sau6 waa6 ngo5 pin1 leon6 man2 se2 dak1 gei2 hou2
ex.en: The professor said my paper was pretty good.

note: Measure word 隻.

ex.r: coeng1 hau2 jau5 zek3 zoek3 zai2
ex.en: There's a little bird at the window.

ex.r: ngo5 je4 je2 joeng5 zo2 loeng5 zek3 zoek3 zai2
ex.en: My grandpa keeps two birds.

ex.s: 朝早聽到雀仔叫，好舒服。
ex.r: ziu1 zou2 teng1 dou2 zoek3 zai2 giu3 hou2 syu1 fuk6
ex.en: Hearing birds sing in the morning is lovely.

note: In speech, amounts use 蚊 man1: 一百蚊.

ex.r: ni1 dou6 sau1 m4 sau1 gong2 bai6 gaa3
ex.en: Do you take Hong Kong dollars here?

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 wun6 jat1 cin1 man1 gong2 bai6
ex.en: I'd like to change money for a thousand HK dollars.

ex.r: zoeng1 fei1 ng5 baak3 man1 gong2 bai6
ex.en: The ticket is 500 HK dollars.

ex.r: m4 hou2 kei4 mong6 taai3 gou1
ex.en: Don't expect too much.

ex.r: ngo5 baa4 maa1 deoi3 ngo5 kei4 mong6 hou2 daai6
ex.en: My parents expect a lot of me.

ex.s: 間餐廳冇我期望咁好食。
ex.r: gaan1 caan1 teng1 mou5 ngo5 kei4 mong6 gam3 hou2 sik6
ex.en: The restaurant wasn't as good as I expected.

note: In HK 奶奶 = husband's mother; paternal grandma is 嫲嫲.

ex.s: 今個星期日去奶奶度食飯。
ex.r: gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 heoi3 naai4 naai2 dou6 sik6 faan6
ex.en: This Sunday we're having dinner at my mother-in-law's.

ex.r: ngo5 naai4 naai2 hou2 tung3 ngo5 go3 zai2
ex.en: My mother-in-law adores my son.

ex.r: ngo5 tung4 naai4 naai2 soeng1 cyu5 dak1 gei2 hou2
ex.en: I get along pretty well with my mother-in-law.

note: Usually with 喇 at the end: 就快到喇.

ex.r: ngo5 zau6 faai3 dou3 laa3 dang2 do1 zan6
ex.en: I'm almost there; wait a bit.

ex.r: zau6 faai3 lok6 jyu5 laa3 daai3 baa2 ze1 laa1
ex.en: It's about to rain; take an umbrella.

ex.r: ngo5 bou6 sau2 gei1 zau6 faai3 mou5 din6 laa3
ex.en: My phone is about to die.

ex.r: keoi5 gin1 ci4 jiu3 bei2 cin2
ex.en: He insisted on paying.

ex.r: ngo5 gin1 ci4 mui5 jat6 paau2 bou6
ex.en: I stick to running every day.

ex.r: hok6 jyu5 jin4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 gin1 ci4
ex.en: With languages, sticking with it matters most.

note: Also a verb: to go in.

ex.r: cat1 dim2 hoi1 ci2 jap6 coeng4
ex.en: Doors open at seven.

ex.r: siu2 pang4 jau5 jap6 coeng4 min5 fai3
ex.en: Kids get in free.

ex.r: jap6 coeng4 jiu3 tai2 san1 fan2 zing3
ex.en: You have to show ID to get in.

note: 同人道歉 = apologize to someone.

ex.r: nei5 jing1 goi1 tung4 keoi5 dou6 hip3
ex.en: You should apologize to her.

ex.s: 餐廳經理親自出嚟道歉。
ex.r: caan1 teng1 ging1 lei5 can1 zi6 ceot1 lai4 dou6 hip3
ex.en: The restaurant manager came out to apologize in person.

ex.r: m4 sai2 dou6 hip3 mou5 si6
ex.en: No need to apologize; it's fine.

en: to stare at; keep an eye on
note: Usually 盯住.

ex.r: nei5 deng1 zyu6 ngo5 zou6 mat1
ex.en: Why are you staring at me?

ex.r: bong1 ngo5 deng1 zyu6 di1 hang4 lei5
ex.en: Keep an eye on the luggage for me.

ex.r: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 deng1 zyu6 bou6 din6 nou5
ex.en: Don't stare at the computer all day.

note: Casual and fairly strong; don't say it to someone's face.

ex.r: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1
ex.en: The way he talks is so obnoxious.

ex.r: daa2 zim1 ge3 jan4 zan1 hai6 hat1 jan4 zang1
ex.en: People who cut in line are so annoying.

ex.s: 隻蚊成晚喺度飛，好乞人憎。
ex.r: zek3 man1 seng4 maan5 hai2 dou6 fei1 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1
ex.en: That mosquito flew around all night; so annoying.

ex.r: king1 zo2 gam3 noi6 jau5 mou5 git3 leon6 aa3
ex.en: After all that talk, any conclusion?

ex.r: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 lok6 git3 leon6
ex.en: Don't jump to conclusions.

ex.s: 醫生嘅結論係冇大問題。
ex.r: ji1 sang1 ge3 git3 leon6 hai6 mou5 daai6 man6 tai4
ex.en: The doctor's conclusion was that it's nothing serious.

ex.r: gam1 maan5 ge3 jin2 ceot1 gei2 dim2 hoi1 ci2
ex.en: What time does tonight's show start?

ex.s: 我個女聽日喺學校演出。
ex.r: ngo5 go3 neoi2 ting1 jat6 hai2 hok6 haau6 jin2 ceot1
ex.en: My daughter is performing at school tomorrow.

ex.r: keoi5 dei6 ge3 jin2 ceot1 hou2 zing1 coi2
ex.en: Their performance was brilliant.

note: For cutting food, 切 cit3 is usual; 割親 = cut oneself.

ex.r: ngo5 cit3 coi3 got3 can1 sau2 zi2
ex.en: I cut my finger chopping vegetables.

ex.r: siu2 sam1 zoeng1 zi2 got3 can1 nei5
ex.en: Careful, the paper could cut you.

ex.r: baa4 baa1 sing1 kei4 luk6 got3 cou2
ex.en: Dad mows the lawn on Saturdays.

ex.r: keoi5 ci4 dou3 ge3 ho2 nang4 sing3 hou2 daai6
ex.en: There's a good chance he'll be late.

ex.s: 聽日落雨嘅可能性唔高。
ex.r: ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 ge3 ho2 nang4 sing3 m4 gou1
ex.en: Rain tomorrow isn't very likely.

ex.r: jau5 mou5 ho2 nang4 sing3 goi2 kei4 aa3
ex.en: Is there any chance of rescheduling?

ex.s: 當年我哋讀書嗰陣好窮。
ex.r: dong1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 duk6 syu1 go2 zan6 hou2 kung4
ex.en: Back when we were students, we were broke.

ex.s: 我爸爸當年一個人嚟香港。
ex.r: ngo5 baa4 baa1 dong1 nin4 jat1 go3 jan4 lai4 hoeng1 gong2
ex.en: Back then, my dad came to Hong Kong on his own.

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 tung4 dong1 nin4 jat1 joeng6
ex.en: This shop is just like it was back then.

note: Colloquial; rude if said about a person's looks.

ex.r: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 juk6 syun1 m4 hou2 maai5
ex.en: This top is hideous; don't buy it.

ex.r: keoi5 sik6 je5 hou2 daai6 seng1 hou2 juk6 syun1
ex.en: He eats so noisily; it's gross.

ex.s: 張相影得我好肉酸，刪咗佢啦。
ex.r: zoeng1 soeng2 jing2 dak1 ngo5 hou2 juk6 syun1 saan1 zo2 keoi5 laa1
ex.en: I look awful in that photo; delete it.

note: 八折 = 20% off (you pay 80%).

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 pou3 cyun4 coeng4 baat3 zit3
ex.en: Everything in this shop is 20% off.

ex.r: wui6 jyun4 jau5 mou5 zit3 gaa3
ex.en: Do members get a discount?

ex.r: bong1 ngo5 zoeng1 zoeng1 zi2 zit3 hoi1 loeng5 bun3
ex.en: Fold the paper in half for me.

note: Measure word 場 coeng4.

ex.r: ngo5 coeng2 dou2 jin2 coeng3 wui2 fei1 laa3
ex.en: I got concert tickets!

ex.r: jin2 coeng3 wui2 gei2 dim2 jyun4 aa3
ex.en: What time does the concert end?

ex.r: ngo5 tung4 lou5 gung1 heoi3 tai2 jin2 coeng3 wui2
ex.en: My husband and I are going to a concert.

ex.r: nei5 gam3 daai6 go3 jan4 zung6 gam3 jau3 zi6
ex.en: You're a grown-up and still so childish.

ex.r: m4 hou2 gam3 jau3 zi6 laa1
ex.en: Don't be so childish.

ex.r: ni1 tou3 hei3 jau5 di1 jau3 zi6
ex.en: This movie is a bit childish.

ex.r: ngo5 heoi3 tou4 syu1 gun2 waan4 syu1
ex.en: I'm going to the library to return books.

ex.r: tou4 syu1 gun2 gei2 dim2 saan1 mun4
ex.en: What time does the library close?

ex.s: 圖書館入面唔可以講電話。
ex.r: tou4 syu1 gun2 jap6 min6 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 din6 waa2
ex.en: You can't talk on the phone in the library.

note: Measure word 間.

ex.s: 佢哋喺西貢租咗間別墅過週末。
ex.r: keoi5 dei6 hai2 sai1 gung3 zou1 zo2 gaan1 bit6 seoi6 gwo3 zau1 mut6
ex.en: They rented a villa in Sai Kung for the weekend.

ex.r: ngo5 mung6 soeng2 zyu6 bit6 seoi6
ex.en: My dream is to live in a house of my own.

ex.s: 間別墅有個好大嘅花園。
ex.r: gaan1 bit6 seoi6 jau5 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 faa1 jyun2
ex.en: The villa has a big garden.

ex.r: lau4 haa6 gaan1 caan1 teng1 dou2 bai3 zo2
ex.en: The restaurant downstairs closed down.

ex.s: 租咁貴，好多舖頭都倒閉。
ex.r: zou1 gam3 gwai3 hou2 do1 pou3 tau2 dou1 dou2 bai3
ex.en: With rent so high, lots of shops go under.

ex.s: 佢公司倒閉咗，而家搵緊工。
ex.r: keoi5 gung1 si1 dou2 bai3 zo2 ji4 gaa1 wan2 gan2 gung1
ex.en: His company went bust; he's job hunting now.

note: Formal, on signs; in speech 用 jung6 is usual.

ex.r: ni1 dou6 m4 ho2 ji5 sai2 jung6 sau2 gei1
ex.en: You can't use phones here.

ex.s: 使用之前要睇清楚說明書。
ex.r: sai2 jung6 zi1 cin4 jiu3 tai2 cing1 co2 syut3 ming4 syu1
ex.en: Read the manual carefully before using it.

ex.r: gin6 san1 sat1 zi2 haan6 zyu6 haak3 sai2 jung6
ex.en: The gym is for residents only.

ex.r: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou6 ji6 sau2 ce1
ex.en: I bought a used car.

ex.r: di1 ji6 sau2 syu1 hou2 peng4
ex.en: The second-hand books are cheap.

ex.r: bou6 ji6 sau2 sau2 gei1 jung6 dak1 gei2 hou2
ex.en: The second-hand phone works pretty well.

ex.s: 我諗緊辭職，份工太辛苦。
ex.r: ngo5 nam2 gan2 ci4 zik1 fan6 gung1 taai3 san1 fu2
ex.en: I'm thinking of quitting; the job is too tough.

ex.r: keoi5 soeng6 go3 jyut6 ci4 zik1 laa3
ex.en: She quit last month.

ex.r: ci4 zik1 jiu3 bei2 jat1 go3 jyut6 tung1 zi1
ex.en: You have to give a month's notice to resign.

note: Gifts brought back for friends; Mandarin 伴手禮 isn't used.

ex.s: 我去日本帶咗啲手信返嚟。
ex.r: ngo5 heoi3 jat6 bun2 daai3 zo2 di1 sau2 seon3 faan1 lai4
ex.en: I brought back some gifts from Japan.

ex.r: ni1 hap6 zyu1 gu1 lik1 hai6 sau2 seon3
ex.en: This box of chocolates is a gift from my trip.

ex.s: 去旅行記得買手信畀同事。
ex.r: heoi3 leoi5 hang4 gei3 dak1 maai5 sau2 seon3 bei2 tung4 si6
ex.en: Remember to buy gifts for coworkers on your trip.

ex.r: maak3 daai6 go3 hau2 dang2 ngo5 tai2 haa5
ex.en: Open wide and let me take a look.

ex.r: keoi5 maak3 daai6 deoi3 ngaan5 mong6 zyu6 ngo5
ex.en: She stared at me wide-eyed.

ex.r: maak3 daai6 ngaan5 tai2 cing1 co2 di1 laa1
ex.en: Open your eyes and look carefully!

ex.r: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 si4 zong1 zaap6 zi3
ex.en: She loves reading fashion magazines.

ex.s: 呢個商場有好多時裝舖。
ex.r: ni1 go3 soeng1 coeng4 jau5 hou2 do1 si4 zong1 pou3
ex.en: This mall has lots of clothing shops.

ex.s: 我細妹喺時裝公司返工。
ex.r: ngo5 sai3 mui2 hai2 si4 zong1 gung1 si1 faan1 gung1
ex.en: My younger sister works at a fashion company.

note: Mandarin 每天早上; also 朝朝早.

ex.r: ngo5 ziu1 ziu1 dou1 jam2 gaa3 fe1
ex.en: I drink coffee every morning.

ex.r: keoi5 ziu1 ziu1 cat1 dim2 ceot1 mun4 hau2
ex.en: He leaves the house at seven every morning.

ex.r: ziu1 ziu1 daap3 dei6 tit3 dou1 hou2 bik1
ex.en: The MTR is packed every morning.

note: 肚餓 hungry; 肚痛 stomachache.

ex.r: ngo5 hou2 tou5 ngo6 aa3
ex.en: I'm so hungry.

ex.r: ngo5 tou5 tung3 gam1 jat6 m4 faan1 gung1 laa3
ex.en: I've got a stomachache; I'm not going to work today.

ex.r: sik6 zo2 loeng5 wun2 faan6 go3 tou5 hou2 zoeng3
